items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He left with Mimmy Smith, you know.

ctx.x: He was a different fella. He was to take us away with a show. Uh huh. Mimmy Smith, you know, which is . Yeah. But then we had packed up and we had to go. But T-Boy and mother and sister didn't want him to go. So after we couldn't take T-Boy, he backed out. We had to back out. So he left there with some kind of a show. I don't know. He left with Mimmy Smith, you know. He left with Mimmy Smith, you know. But he wanted us, you know. They had signed a contract, too. You know, but we hadn't got no money down on it,…
Mm-hm. After he played with you, who did he go with?
